title: zl.sub
description: find a sublist in a list

messages.description: performs the operation again on the last received list
position of each occurrence, counting from 1

methods.description: clears the mode's arguments and the data received in both inlets
sets the maximum list size, 1 to 32767

body: [zl.sub] searches a list for occurrences of another one, set by the arguments or the right inlet. The right outlet sends the number of occurrences, and the left outlet the position of each one, counting from 1. When there are none, the right outlet sends 0.
